Name: Parchment
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49525/49525-1784825283-1153364983.png[/img]
Parchment is a framework which allows mod authors to create fully customizable in-game books via JSON. These books can be accessed via game objects or through other means (such as a tile action).

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49525/49525-1784784782-246843.gif[/img]

Parchment makes full use of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], allowing authors to dynamically change how their book are created and displayed.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49525/49525-1784825283-1362744529.png[/img]
To get started with Parchment, see the [url=https://floogen.github.io/Parchment]documentation here[/url] or look at the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/Parchment/tree/development/Parchment/Content%20Packs/%5BCP%5D%20Parchment%20Example%20Pack]example pack[/url]. The [url=https://github.com/Floogen/Campgrounds/tree/development/Campgrounds/Content%20Packs/%5BCP%5D%20Campgrounds/assets/parchment]Camping Guide[/url] from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49526]Campgrounds [/url]is also a good reference, utilizing various features of this framework.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49525/49525-1784825286-1964268893.png[/img]
Some assets were originally created by Gowl and Pixel Vault on itch.io and modified according their respective licenses.

See credits.txt for additional details (within the example packs).

Source code can be [url=https://github.com/Floogen/Parchment]found here[/url].
